profiles.bio: Product designer obsessed with specialty coffee, film cameras, and trail running on misty mornings. Looking for deep conversations and spontaneous road trips.
Connectly Community Trust & Safety Team. Dedicated to keeping our community respectful, safe, and authentic.
Architect by day, ceramicist by weekend. Living for golden hour gallery walks, farmers markets, and discovering hidden noodle spots.
Sound engineer and vinyl collector. Always planning my next backpacking trip or perfecting my sourdough starter. Tell me your top 3 albums.
Marine biologist & scuba divemaster. Passionate about ocean conservation, indie bookstores, and late-night spicy hotpot debates.
Botanist running an urban plant conservatory. Big fan of weekend trail cycling, jazz cafes, and making homemade pasta from scratch.
Curator & documentary filmmaker exploring folklore and contemporary art. Looking for someone grounded, humorous, and curious about the world.
Rock climbing coach & environmental lawyer. I spend my weekends in Yosemite or brewing pour-overs with ambient lo-fi tracks in the background.
Robotics software researcher and amateur stand-up comic. Can teach you how to build a quadcopter or where to find the crispest croissants in the city.
Bossa nova guitarist & pastry chef. Born in Rio, settled in the Bay. Let me bake you warm pastel de nata and share stories from South America.
Ceramicist & matcha enthusiast. You will usually find me covered in clay at my studio or biking along the Embarcadero with a film camera.
Clean-tech founder working on renewable grid storage. Weekend trail runner, Afrobeats DJ, and passionate about community gardens.
Fashion archivist & vintage boutique owner. Lover of flea markets in Paris, natural wine, typography, and French cinema.
Game designer & indie developer. Into tabletop strategy games, sci-fi novels, specialty pour-overs, and bouldering.
Sommelier and food writer. Traveling through vineyards, hosting dinner parties, and hunting down the best handmade gnocchi in town.
Civil engineer focused on sustainable transit. Cyclist, amateur astrophotographer, and believer that kindness and curiosity make the best partners.
Salsa instructor & pediatric nurse. Big energy, contagious laugh, and passionate about music that makes you want to get up and dance.
Illustrator and zine maker. Always sketching dogs in Dolores Park or hunting for vintage synthesizers. Seeking someone genuine and playful.
Woodworker crafting custom Scandinavian furniture. Big reader, loves camping under desert stars and cooking slow-simmered stews.
Astrophysics postdoc gazing at distant galaxies by night, practicing vinyasa yoga by day. Looking for someone with emotional intelligence and intellectual curiosity.
Photojournalist covering cultural festivals & environmental restoration. High energy, loves street food night markets, and impromptu guitar jams.
Veterinarian with a heart for rescue animals. Big on cozy rainy days, making handmade pottery, and hiking along coastal bluffs.
profiles.education: UC Davis School of Veterinary Medicine

messages.message: Hey Taylor! I saw in your profile that you love specialty pour-overs! Have you tried the new Ethiopian roast at Saint Frank?
Hey Sophia! Yes! Saint Frank's natural process is incredible. We should definitely grab one sometime and check out the gallery on Polk Street.
I'd love that! Are you free this Saturday afternoon around 2?
Loved your trail running photos! Have you done the Dipsea trail yet?
